verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is in Patent Center, where 'Sponsored support staff' can prepare and save submissions that 'Corresponding Practitioners' can access. That implies a sanctioned practitioner and sponsorship delegation model, but the pack documents it only in passing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how a company appoints an authorized representative or practitioner (e.g., power of attorney or attorney of record), how a third-party provider is sponsored or authorized to act in Trademark Center and Patent Center, scope and revocation of that delegated access, and any independent corroboration.
